chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 467: Ji Ning's Thousand-Year Heart Trial
chapter_meta_description: After 300 years of solitude in the Realm of Annihilation, Ji Ning steps out of the void, his Dao-heart honed by a thousand lives. The sword is ready to return.
og_title: Ji Ning Finally Walks Out of the Void
og_description: After a long, lonely training arc, the Sword Immortal decides it's time to go home.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's Return from the Void!
twitter_description: 300 years alone in the Realm of Annihilation. A thousand lives lived in the heart. The wait is over.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; allows the user to create 'Self-Created Worlds' within their own mind.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
A Heartforce technique where the cultivator constructs a complete inner universe within their Dao-heart, allowing them to live vivid lifetimes to temper their soul.
A supreme Dao related to absolute destruction and ending; the novel uses 'Oblivion' to denote the ultimate state of nothingness.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning come back?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He realized his humanity was starving; cultivating forever in isolation would eventually break his Dao-heart instead of strengthening it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Realm of Annihilation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a scar between worlds—a void with no Dao, no light, and no life, used only for the most extreme Fiendgod or Heartforce training.
It is a Heartforce technique where Ji Ning builds a living universe inside his own heart and lives full lifetimes within it to rapidly temper his Dao-heart.
